name: dsh-hooks-pack
description: One-click Claude Code & Codex hooks for DeepSeek Harness: auto-discovers your existing ~/.claude / ~/.codex hook config and runs it on the official bridge plugins, with an explicit sandbox-policy shim so hook commands never die silently.
longDescription: Wraps the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code and @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-codex bridges behind one bundle row. Auto-discovers existing hook configs at standard locations, injects an explicit sandboxPolicy into hook command execution (the executor fail-safe default breaks hooks on some Windows deployments), and no-ops cleanly when no config exists. Verified end-to-end: PreToolUse deny decisions block tool calls; SessionStart additionalContext reaches the model.
